name: Somchai Dechawuth
bio:
Somchai's journey into motorsport began with a childhood fascination for remote control cars, leading him to pursue a degree in mechanical engineering at Chulalongkorn University. After graduating, he secured a position at a local automotive manufacturer, quickly distinguishing himself with his problem-solving abilities and keen eye for detail. Eager to apply his skills to racing, he volunteered at local racing events, eventually earning a spot on a small touring car team.

His dedication and technical acumen led him to AF Corse, where he has spent the last several years honing his expertise in vehicle dynamics and race strategy. Somchai is known for his methodical approach to engineering challenges, emphasizing data analysis and simulation to optimize performance. He believes in empowering his team members, fostering a collaborative environment where everyone feels valued and contributes to the collective success. He is particularly passionate about exploring innovative solutions within existing regulations, finding the marginal gains that can make a significant difference on the track.
